# CG-REQ-007: Request parameter location changed

A parameter with the same name moved to a different location (query, header, path, cookie).

**Why it matters:** The value is no longer received where consumers send it.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Requests](./#req) |
| Detects | `parameter.locationChanged` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> Parameter moved from {fromIn} to {toIn} ({where}).
>
> Consumers still send it in {fromIn}; the provider now reads it from {toIn}.
>
> **Fix:** Accept the parameter in both locations during a transition.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: query → header, required

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       parameters: [{name: api_key, in: query, schema: {type: string}}]
+       parameters: [{name: api_key, in: header, required: true, schema: {type: string}}]
        responses: {'200': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** Breaking, high. Parameter moved from query to header (GET /x: query parameter "api_key").

### Fires: optional moved

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       parameters: [{name: api_key, in: query, schema: {type: string}}]
+       parameters: [{name: API_KEY, in: cookie, schema: {type: string}}]
        responses: {'200': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** Potentially breaking, medium. Parameter moved from query to cookie (GET /x: query parameter "api_key").

### Does not fire: different name

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       parameters: [{name: a, in: query, schema: {type: string}}]
+       parameters: [{name: b, in: header, schema: {type: string}}]
        responses: {'200': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

## Limitations

- Header names are case-insensitive; other locations are not.

## Silence or tune it

```yaml
rules:
  ignore:
    - rule: CG-REQ-007
      operation: "GET /example"   # optional: narrow it down
      reason: "Explain why this is acceptable"
      expires: 2027-01-01         # optional
  overrides:
    CG-REQ-007: { severity: low }
```
